title: NAACP Image Awards Adds 10 New African Categories for 2027
summary: The organization seeks to celebrate the continent’s growing influence across film, television and music.
body: The NAACP Image Awards have added 10 new categories to recognize the achievements of African artists. Previously, there were no dedicated African categories. title: With Some Musicians Losing Their Hearing, These Are the Best Earplugs for Noise Reduction
summary: Several musicians have spoken openly about the impact of loud music on their hearing, highlighting the growing importance of earplugs as a form of protection.
body: All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. In an increasingly noisy world, our hearing is taking a beating, and for musicians, the loud sounds that make their work possible can also become an occupational hazard. That risk has gained attention as BTS member V recently revealed he was receiving treatment for significant hearing loss while on tour, while DJ and producer Alesso spoke about tinnitus and its impact on his touring last year. Furthermore, Chris Martin, Dave Grohl and Neil Young are among the other artists who have opened up about the impact years of exposure to loud music has had on their ears. While custom in-ear monitors (IEMs) can be an alternative to earplugs, they don’t suit every musician and music event. title: Bad Bunny Wins Key Ruling in Massive Reggaeton Lawsuit
summary: In a rare move reversing his own decision, a judge says he discovered a major flaw in a lawsuit that accuses hundreds of reggaeton songs of infringement.
body: A federal judge has sided with Bad Bunny and struck down a large portion of a massive copyright lawsuit targeting hundreds of artists over the origins of reggaeton. In a rare move that overturns his own earlier decision, Judge André Birotte Jr. ruled Tuesday (Sept. 1) that reggae duo Steely & Clevie had failed to show that they own valid copyright control over the dembow rhythm — the boom-ch-boom-chick beat heard in almost every reggaeton song. The earlier decision had sent the case to trial , which would have meant years more litigation in a sprawling case that targets Bunny, Karol G, Daddy Yankee and dozens of other artists over nearly 2,000 songs that are alleged to illegally feature the offending rhythm. But in a decision obtained and first reported by Billboard , Judge Birotte said he had been swayed to reconsider that ruling by Bad Bunny’s lawyers’ recent argument : that Steely & Clevie were improperly citing multiple songs and mashing them together into a “Frankenstein copyright.” “Upon further review of the record, the court concludes that plaintiffs have not clearly identified what copyrighted work contains the allegedly protectable selection and arrangement…

title: Josh Groban’s Find Your Light Benefit Concert Will Honor This Famed Trumpeter & Include a Performance by a Boy Bander
summary: Groban will host the event, which is set for Oct. 19 at Jazz at Lincoln Center.
body: The third annual Find Your Light Benefit Concert for Arts Education featuring Josh Groban and Friends will take place on Monday, Oct. 19, in the Appel Room at Jazz at Lincoln Center. Hosted by Groban, the concert will honor trumpeter and composer Wynton Marsalis and The Oliver Sacks Foundation. The event will feature performances and appearances by Groban, Marsalis, Stephen Colbert , Louis Cato, Betsy Wolfe, Lorna Courtney, *NSYNC’s Joey Fatone and more. title: Alejandro Fernández, Maná & More Set for Star-Studded Mexican Independence Day Las Vegas Lineup
summary: Check out the schedule for the event taking place Sept. 11-16.
body: A host of Latin stars will arrive in Las Vegas to take part in the traditional Mexican Independence Day celebrations, with an ambitious lineup that includes Alejandro Fernández , Carlos Santana , Maná , Marc Anthony , Marco Antonio Solís and Los Tucanes de Tijuana , performing at 10 different venues throughout the city, Live Nation Las Vegas announced on Tuesday (Sept. 1). This year’s impressive roster also includes Los Ángeles Azules , Zoé , Soda Stereo , Chuy Lizárraga & Julio Preciado, Grupo Duelo, José María Napoleón, Matute, Palomazo Norteño, Teo González & Jorge Falcón and Yolanda del Río , as well as famous comedians. Mexican Independence Day is celebrated on the evening of Sept. 15 to commemorate the Cry of Dolores, which re-enacts the speech given by Father Miguel Hidalgo in the historic early morning hours of Sept. 16, 1810, in Dolores Hidalgo, Guanajuato. Below is the lineup for the Mexican Independence Day weekend: Sept. 1 1 Stand-up comedian Alfred Robles will return to The Palazzo Theatre at The Venetian Resort Las Vegas with his “Vatos with Gatos” Tour. title: September 2026 Satellite Puzzler
summary: Here’s the August 2026 puzzler. Quick, where is this? And what makes this place interesting or unique?
body: Every month, NASA Earth Observatory features a puzzling satellite image. The September 2026 puzzler appears above. Your Challenge I dentify the location shown in this satellite image. Share what clues you see, where you think it is, and what makes this place interesting or unique to you. How to Answer Submit your response using this form and select “Puzzler Answer” as the topic. Please include your preferred name or alias. You can keep it simple and just guess the location. Want to impress us? Tell us which satellite and instrument captured the image, which spectral bands were used, or point out a subtle detail about the geology or history of the area. If something catches your eye, or if this is your home or means something to you, we’d love to hear about it. The Prize We can’t offer prize money or a trip to space to see Earth like satellites and astronauts do . But we can offer something almost as rewarding: puzzler bragging rights.
